name: setlist-gestures
note: S-SETLIST-GESTURES (operator UAT 2026-09-03: 'change drag to press and hold on song on setlist' + 'change setlist delete to slide swipe... like outlook and Gmail mobile. both directions are delete'). Replaces the grip-drag (setlist-remove-arm's old two-tap arm-x is retired too - see that scenario's own note). Proves: (1) the grip and the always-on arm-x are gone from a set row's resting look; (2) a real Playwright mouse drag (dragReorder, the SAME verb S-PROG-REORDER already proved reorder with) started from the ROW BODY - no dedicated handle any more - reorders the set; (3) a synthetic PointerEvent sequence dispatched from inside the page (no runner change - dragSwipe is not an existing verb and run-scenario.py is out of this mission's scope) proves a >=25% horizontal drag commits a delete through the SAME removeFromSet+undo path every other remove uses, and a <25% drag springs back without removing anything.

steps.label: 3 set rows, none carry the old grip handle or an always-visible remove x - the row itself is the gesture surface now
every set row wraps its content in .li-inner behind a .li-swipe-bg danger underlay carrying both direction glyphs
WCAG 2.5.1 a11y fallback: li-up is invisible at rest (a11y-only, not a new tap surface) but reveals to its real size on keyboard focus
the a11y li-up control ACTUALLY reorders (same onUp handler the row gesture drives) - row 2 swaps with row 1, no gesture involved
steps.js: (function(){var titlesBefore=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#setBody .li-title')).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim()});var up=document.querySelector('#setBody .listItem:nth-of-type(2) .li-up');if(!up)return 'no li-up';up.click();var titlesAfter=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#setBody .li-title')).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim()});return titlesAfter.length===3 && titlesAfter[0]===titlesBefore[1] && titlesAfter[1]===titlesBefore[0] && titlesAfter[2]===titlesBefore[2]})()

steps.label: the a11y li-rm control still runs the SAME arm-then-confirm gate as ever - one click only ARMS, it must not remove yet
a second click on the now-armed a11y li-rm removes - through the exact same list-item.js dispatch gate, keyboard-operable end to end
back to 3 songs for the gesture proofs below - undo the a11y-path remove
capture the starting title order for the reorder proof below
press-and-hold reorder (mouse: movement-lift from the ROW body, no grip) moved song 1 to the end - order [2,3,1]
steps.js: (function(){var t=window.__s1titles;var now=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#setBody .li-title')).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim()});return now.length===3 && now[0]===t[1] && now[1]===t[2] && now[2]===t[0]})()

steps.label: nothing deleted by the reorder - still 3 rows

a SMALL swipe (10% of row width, mouse pointerType, dispatched from inside the page - no runner verb exists for an in-place horizontal drag) springs back: row count unchanged and the swipe classes/custom-property are cleaned up
spring-back settled: 3 rows still, no swipe classes left, --swipe-x cleared
a swipe under threshold never fires tap-to-play either (the trailing-click swallow) - the Practice screen (s-practice) never activated, still on Library
a BIG swipe (40% of row width, past the 25% commit threshold, direction RIGHT) removes the row
commit settled: down to 2 rows - the SAME removeFromSet path fired (not a bespoke swipe-only remove)
the undo banner offered after the swipe-commit remove - same as any other setlist remove
swiping the OTHER direction (LEFT, negative dx, past threshold) also deletes - both directions delete
leftward swipe-commit removed too - down to 1 row
